sloka: स तस्य गिरिवर्यस्य तले नागवरायुते ।तिष्ठन् कपिवरस्तत्र ह्रदे नाग इवाबभौ ॥५-१-७॥
transliteration: sa tasya girivaryasya tale nāgavarāyute ।tiṣṭhan kapivarastatra hrade nāga ivābabhau ॥5-1-7॥

translations.english: As the monkey leader stood at the foot of the great mountain filled with lordly elephants he looked like an elephant standing at the centre of a pond.
